title: Notation adapter: Python parse/format module
description: Create python/baize/notation.py with: parse_move(text, session) -> Action and format_move(action, session) -> str. Reads notation block from game definition. Layer 1: grid label coordinate lookup (file+rank -> col,row). Layer 2: piece symbol resolution, capture marker, disambiguation against legal moves, promotion parsing, special move keywords. Output: format_move generates human-readable text from Action.
close_reason: notation.py module with parse_move/format_move, label mapping, piece symbols, special moves. 18 tests.
